title: Markyn Ring of Majesty
enchantDescription: Adds |cffffff169|r Stamina Recovery.
flavorText: Carved from morpholith and crowned with a searing gem, this Daedric ring weighs heavy on the hand. All the malice of the Kyn dwells in its many loops—as does the glory of their warrior barons.
name: Markyn Ring of Majesty

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) Gain |cffffff100|r Weapon and Spell Damage and |cffffff1157|r Armor for every set you are wearing 3 or more pieces of.

Current bonus: |cffffff100|r Weapon and Spell Damage and |cffffff1157|r Armor.

traitDescription: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage against enemies under |cFFFFFF90|r% Health by up to |cffffff350|r.

title: Belharza's Band
enchantDescription: Adds |cffffff169|r Stamina Recovery.
flavorText: The bull horn centerpiece of this Imperial band seems to goad the wearer—challenging them to crush their foes and unleash the ring's fury.
name: Belharza's Band

setBonuses.description:
(1 item) Increase the damage of your Light Attacks by |cffffff900|r.

When you deal damage with consecutive melee Light Attacks, gain a stack of Belharza's Temper for |cffffff10|r seconds, up to 5 stacks max. At 5 stacks, consume Belharza's Temper and after |cffffff1|r second, deal |cffffff8026|r Physical Damage to enemies in a line and stun them for |cffffff3|r seconds. This effect can occur once every |cffffff10|r seconds and scales off the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage.

traitDescription: Increases your Weapon and Spell Damage against enemies under |cFFFFFF90|r% Health by up to |cffffff350|r.

title: Daedric Enchanting Station
flavorText: Who knows what vile enchantments took shape on this Daedric worktable? Perhaps you can craft something even darker. When placed in your home, this crafting station allows you to craft Enchantment items.
name: Daedric Enchanting Station

title: Dagon's Scalding Gibbet
flavorText: Fear is a tool best used in moderation, but when you must turn to it, be ready with the appropriate accessories. This torture device, for instance—even looking at it may cause some to spill their secrets.
name: Dagon's Scalding Gibbet

title: Tree, Charred Dagonic
flavorText: How this skeleton of a burned tree once grew here remains a mystery.
name: Tree, Charred Dagonic

title: Deadlands Window, Stormglass
flavorText: While most associate Deadlands architecture with fiery reds, the deep blues of a churning sea are no less intimidating. Let the cold light of a rising flood wash over you when standing before this Daedric window.
name: Deadlands Window, Stormglass

title: Daedric Altar, Mehrunes Dagon
flavorText: No place of worship dedicated to the Prince of Destruction can be called such without this altar. If you can't please Mehrunes Dagon, best make sure you don't anger him by lacking this centerpiece.
name: Daedric Altar, Mehrunes Dagon

title: Deadlands Lightning Rod, Etched
flavorText: If you dare to live among the storms of the Sever, be sure to place plenty of lightning rods around. The fact that these might scare off cowardly mortals is a welcome perk.
name: Deadlands Lightning Rod, Etched

title: Deadlands Wind Gate Pinion
flavorText: This majestic stone structure draws the gaze even as it dominates the landscape. Perfect as a focal piece in your courtyard or bit of Oblivion.
name: Deadlands Wind Gate Pinion

title: Deadlands Buttress, Large
flavorText: Decorate and support your walls in Daedric style with this towering buttress. While it won't stop Dagon himself from entering your abode if he wishes, lesser beings might reconsider any plans to besiege your residence.
name: Deadlands Buttress, Large

title: Deadlands Buttress
flavorText: For those needing added structural support for their walls, this Daedric-themed buttress serves the purpose while adding a touch of dread to your home.
name: Deadlands Buttress

title: Deadlands Platform, Octagonal
flavorText: Every second-rate baron needs a platform on which to stand. But why settle for second-rate mortal sovereignty when you can go full doom and destruction with this Daedric-themed platform?
name: Deadlands Platform, Octagonal

title: Deadlands Displacer, Inactive
flavorText: This inert displacer might not whisk you off to points unknown, but it will lend any room you place it in an air of arcane mystery!
name: Deadlands Displacer, Inactive

title: Portal Key Replica
flavorText: Though this item is a mere replica of a real portal key, the memories it unlocks for you can be priceless. Maybe a bit hair-raising, but definitely priceless.
name: Portal Key Replica

title: Deadlands Wall, Wide
flavorText: This is a large house item.
name: Deadlands Wall, Wide

title: Sulfur Pool
flavorText: Some of Madam Whim's clients swear by the relaxing properties of the mud from Deadlands sulfur pools. Others find these pools to be more useful than "keep out" signs. Which are you?
name: Sulfur Pool

title: Leyawiin Wall, Castle
flavorText: This is a large house item.
name: Leyawiin Wall, Castle

title: Undaunted Reward Box
flavorText: This box, found only during the Undaunted Celebration, contains valuable treasure - including, rarely, gifts from the Crown Store.
name: Undaunted Reward Box

title: Glorious Undaunted Reward Box
flavorText: This box, found only during the Undaunted Celebration, contains valuable treasure - including, rarely, gifts from the Crown Store.
name: Glorious Undaunted Reward Box

title: Style Page: Opal Chokethorn Shoulder
flavorText: Use to learn the Opal Chokethorn Shoulder Outfit Style. This page can be traded, mailed, and posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores. This page is consumed when read, granting you the account-wide Collectible.
name: Style Page: Opal Chokethorn Shoulder

title: Beautifully Rendered Chart
flavorText: This chart is highly detailed with different shades and ink. The strange symbols are rendered in perfect, steady writing.
name: Beautifully Rendered Chart

title: Painted Pocket Dimension Map
flavorText: A colorfully painted map of a previously unknown pocket dimension in Oblivion.
name: Painted Pocket Dimension Map

title: Embroidered Ogrim Cloth
flavorText: This rather lovely, stitched modesty cloth was once adorned by a fashionable Ogrim.
name: Embroidered Ogrim Cloth

title: Sculpted Bearer Pipe
flavorText: A delicately carved pipe, fashioned in the shape of one of the giant skeletons that looks over the city of Fargrave.
name: Sculpted Bearer Pipe

title: Detailed Apparatus Instructions
flavorText: Instructions on how to activate a strange Daedric apparatus, rendered in elaborate black ink and complete with drawings.
name: Detailed Apparatus Instructions

title: Clannfear Brand Patch
flavorText: This patch of skin comes from a Clannfear. A specific symbol was burned into the flesh to mark loyalty to a high ranking Daedra.
name: Clannfear Brand Patch

title: Daedric Scrying Crystal
flavorText: This crystal was likely used to scry the location of a certain artifact, or another Daedra.
name: Daedric Scrying Crystal

title: Dremnaken Hunting Fetish
flavorText: A small totem shaped like a fierce Dremnaken. Its face has been worn smooth by whoever once carried it.
name: Dremnaken Hunting Fetish

title: Mehrunes Dagon Kyn Emblem
flavorText: A Dremora might add this metallic emblem to their cuirass to declare their allegiance to Mehrunes Dagon.
name: Mehrunes Dagon Kyn Emblem

title: Miniature Mehrunes' Razor
flavorText: A very small, but exquisitely detailed replica of the Daedric Prince of Destruction's mythic dagger.
name: Miniature Mehrunes' Razor

title: Claw of an Ash Titan
flavorText: The severed claw of a fearsome Ash Titan. It looks cracked and weathered and was likely used in some kind of dark ritual.
name: Claw of an Ash Titan

title: Dark Seducer Summoning Idol
flavorText: A Daedric summoning idol sculpted into the likeness of a Dark Seducer. It's incredibly detailed.
name: Dark Seducer Summoning Idol

title: Essence of Servitude
flavorText: This bottled substance can be worn by mortals who are bound to a Daedra by a pact. It marks ownership to other Daedra.
name: Essence of Servitude

title: Anchoring Pact Gem
flavorText: A gem that signifies the pact between a Daedra and mortal. This one is no longer used, but still bears inscriptions.
name: Anchoring Pact Gem

title: Mortal Fingerbone Dice
flavorText: Gambling is quite popular among some Daedra. These dice, made from Khajiiti fingers, are used in such games.
name: Mortal Fingerbone Dice

title: Scamp-Skin Painted Tray
flavorText: A board game tray made from stretched and dried Scamp skin. Various unintelligible instructions are tattooed across the surface.
name: Scamp-Skin Painted Tray

title: Ogrim Toss Ball
flavorText: A crude ball made to withstand the hefty kicks of ogrims. It's not clear if the game of Ogrim Toss has any actual rules.
name: Ogrim Toss Ball

title: Deadlands Gaming Tokens
flavorText: These tiny sculptures are made of onyx and serve as pieces in an elaborate game of Daedric strategy.
name: Deadlands Gaming Tokens

title: Dremnaken Racing Paint
flavorText: This specific paint is used to adhere to the flesh of the few Dremnaken who deign to race on behalf of other powerful Daedra.
name: Dremnaken Racing Paint

title: Dice of the Daedric Princes
flavorText: Each die corresponds to a separate Daedric Prince. Each corresponding symbol is filigreed in gold.
name: Dice of the Daedric Princes

title: Ogrim Tooth Sharpener
flavorText: A sharpened pick made specifically for cleaning out the stubborn crevices between ogrim teeth. This one looks unused.
name: Ogrim Tooth Sharpener

title: Dremora Horn Polish
flavorText: A thick, sticky substance with the consistency of honey. It is used to make horns sparkle to a mirror finish.
name: Dremora Horn Polish

title: Clannfear Scale Comb
flavorText: A comb made from the hardened scales of a clannfear. The scales are spaced widely to accommodate many textures of hair.
name: Clannfear Scale Comb

title: Xivilai Tattoo Pen
flavorText: This device is used to put ink deep beneath the flesh. It can give one elaborate and detailed tattoos when used properly.
name: Xivilai Tattoo Pen

title: Handcrafted Mortal Perfume
flavorText: This fragrance is purported to make one smell exactly like a mortal. "The divine odor of inevitable death!
name: Handcrafted Mortal Perfume

title: Eye Charcoal of the Burn
flavorText: This popular shade of eye charcoal comes straight from the magma pits of the Burn.
name: Eye Charcoal of the Burn

title: Redeye Fading Agent
flavorText: For those who suffer from the ill effects of Redmaiden use, this solution clears the eyes of the infamous redness.
name: Redeye Fading Agent

title: Bottle of Suspicious Ink
flavorText: The ink in this bottle is dark red and disturbingly vicious. Probably best not to open it.
name: Bottle of Suspicious Ink

title: Spiddal Plant Paper
flavorText: This paper is thick and rough to the touch--crafted from pulped petals of the tenacious spiddal plant.
name: Spiddal Plant Paper

title: Watcher Tentacle Letter Opener
flavorText: A brutally sharp letter opener made from the severed, petrified tentacle of a Watcher.
name: Watcher Tentacle Letter Opener

title: Markynaz Wax Seal
flavorText: The official wax seal of one of Mehrunes Dagon's most loyal servants.
name: Markynaz Wax Seal

title: Scamp Skull Paperweight
flavorText: A perfect, cleaned skull of a Scamp. Oddly heavier than one might expect.
name: Scamp Skull Paperweight

title: Elegant Bloodthorn Quill
flavorText: A quill made from the perfect blade of a Bloodthorn plant that's been magically preserved.
name: Elegant Bloodthorn Quill

title: Daedric Desk Reference
flavorText: This small booklet contains an incomprehensible list of Daedric sounds and utterances and their translations.
name: Daedric Desk Reference

title: Daedric Flavor Sampler
flavorText: This arcaner contraption allows the curious Daedra to sample flavors of food without actually ingesting them.
name: Daedric Flavor Sampler

title: Palate Infusing Dome
flavorText: This specialized glass dome is placed over meals in order to preserve the essence of flavor. Curious Daedra inhale said essence.
name: Palate Infusing Dome

title: Daedric Pseudomandible
flavorText: This utensil is shaped like a mouth with carved teeth for Daedra curious about mastication in mortal consumption.
name: Daedric Pseudomandible

title: Carved Daedric Frother
flavorText: This finely carved tool is meant to froth various liquids. Consumption of these liquids is typically ill-advised.
name: Carved Daedric Frother

title: Silver Saliva Catcher
flavorText: For those Daedra who wish to taste the strange phenomenon of mortal saliva.
name: Silver Saliva Catcher

title: Painted Spit Bowls
flavorText: Daedra who enjoy the act of eating often bring these spit bowls with them to collect their post-meal leavings.
name: Painted Spit Bowls

title: Hardened Magma Fork
flavorText: A fork lovingly crafted from the hardened magma deposits from the Deadlands.
name: Hardened Magma Fork

title: Spear of Bitter Mercy Toothpick
flavorText: A very tiny rendering of the Spear of Bitter Mercy, meant to clean in-between teeth.
name: Spear of Bitter Mercy Toothpick

title: Stag Horn Fur-Comb
flavorText: This comb is meant to get through tough hides and knots and is shaped like two splayed stag horns.
name: Stag Horn Fur-Comb

title: Woven Stress Deer
flavorText: This tightly woven plaything resembles a deer. Perfect for grawing, squeezing, and clawing in times of stress and frustration.
name: Woven Stress Deer

title: Spear of the Hunter Earring
flavorText: A miniature Spear of the Hunter figurine made into an earring with a small hook.
name: Spear of the Hunter Earring

title: Lycanthrope Guardian Totem
flavorText: A small totem carved with symbols of lycanthropy. It seems to be imbued with Hircine's protection.
name: Lycanthrope Guardian Totem

title: Hooves of the Great Stag Cuffs
flavorText: Formal wear fashioned from fine metals in the form of hooves to honor the Great Stag.
name: Hooves of the Great Stag Cuffs

title: Storihbeg Smoking Pipe
flavorText: A grand smoking pipe fashioned to honor Storihbeg. The smoke pours out of his mouth.
name: Storihbeg Smoking Pipe

title: Polished Hookah Chamber
flavorText: A sturdy glass chamber, once connected to a pipe to facilitate smoking.
name: Polished Hookah Chamber

title: Dremnaken Adjustable Harness
flavorText: This mechanical harness is made to fit a wide variety of feral Dremnaken and helps control their movement.
name: Dremnaken Adjustable Harness

title: Dremora Tattoo Needle
flavorText: An elegant needle often used in the tattooing of various Daedra, either willing or unwilling.
name: Dremora Tattoo Needle

title: Self-Moving Scamp Feeder
flavorText: This feeder siphons incentivizing treats for Scamps in order to alter their behavior.
name: Self-Moving Scamp Feeder

title: Magma Siphoning Lamp
flavorText: A lamp that holds molten magma and harnesses its natural light.
name: Magma Siphoning Lamp

title: Elaborate Daedric Puzzle Box
flavorText: A whirring puzzle box made to entertain the eternally curious Daedra and delight their senses.
name: Elaborate Daedric Puzzle Box

title: Deadlands Storm Anemometer
flavorText: This machine measures the speed of the fierce storming gusts in the Sever.
name: Deadlands Storm Anemometer

title: Daedric Water Clock
flavorText: For those Daedra fascinated by the concept of mortal time, this water clock measures the passage of moments.
name: Daedric Water Clock

title: Compass of the Deadlands
flavorText: This compass would be a useful tool for mortals trying to navigate the Deadlands … if they could read it.
name: Compass of the Deadlands

title: Scamp Reagent Bowl
flavorText: A ceramic bowl shaped like a smiling Scamp. A lid on its head opens to a hollow area for storing alchemical reagents.
name: Scamp Reagent Bowl

title: Deadlands Dust Jar
flavorText: Bright red and roughly textured, this jar appears made from the fire-resistant dust found in Mehrunes Dagon's realm.
name: Deadlands Dust Jar

title: Deboning Kit
flavorText: An elegent set of ivory tools meant for removing the bones from large creatures. They are held in a pale leather satchel.
name: Deboning Kit

title: Greased Onyx Skillet
flavorText: The deep skillet appears jet black and feels slick to the touch. Attempts to clean the grease from it are unsuccessful.
name: Greased Onyx Skillet

title: Old Mournhold Painted Vase
flavorText: This gold-rimmed vase bears an underglaze painting depicting Mehrunes Dagon's destruction of Mournhold.
name: Old Mournhold Painted Vase

title: Molag Bal Canopic Jar
flavorText: A tall, slender jar meant to hold viscera for future purposes. The lid is shaped like the head of Molag Bal.
name: Molag Bal Canopic Jar

title: Leovic Commemorative Plate
flavorText: This plate bears the silhouette of Emperor Leovic in commemoration of his ascension to the Ruby Throne.
name: Leovic Commemorative Plate

title: Barbed Finger Trap
flavorText: This hollow tube's soft interior is lined with barbs that tear at inserted fingers. Intended for use during interrogations.
name: Barbed Finger Trap

title: Clannfear Leash
flavorText: Cut from an unknown scarlet leather, this thick leash restrains even the strongest clannfear as it guards against intruders.
name: Clannfear Leash

title: Binding Cuffs
flavorText: These rough iron cuffs suppress natural Daedric magic, preventing their escape from imprisonment.
name: Binding Cuffs

title: Broken Speaking Stone
flavorText: A smooth, oblong rock once used to communicate long distances between people. The power rune etched into it no longer glows.
name: Broken Speaking Stone

title: Elite Guard Insignia
flavorText: A platinum pin shaped like four clasped hands of Mehrunes Dagon. Worn by Dremora guards of higher caste.
name: Elite Guard Insignia

title: Portable Lantern Frame
flavorText: Light enough to carry on patrol, the frame of this lantern was constructed from the bones of a small animal.
name: Portable Lantern Frame

title: Jar of Daedrat Powder
flavorText: A beige flaky powder sprinkled around a dungeon to keep daedrats from chewing on prisoners.
name: Jar of Daedrat Powder

title: Alchemical Calipers
flavorText: Alchemical experiments require precises amount of biological reagents and this tool can measure with a high degree of accuracy.
name: Alchemical Calipers

title: Voidstone Masonry Set
flavorText: Made of shined grey voidstone, these tools are used to shape rock and mortar when constructing buildings in Oblivion.
name: Voidstone Masonry Set

title: Prey Tracking Tag
flavorText: Once attached to a creature, this thin metal tag cannot be removed. It emits a magical beacon used to hunt the prey.
name: Prey Tracking Tag

title: Daedroth Tooth Pickaxe Head
flavorText: The grey head of a pickaxe made from one of few substances known to pierce Deadlands' stone—the preserved tooth of a Daedroth.
name: Daedroth Tooth Pickaxe Head

title: Hunger Acid Sac
flavorText: Extracted from a hunger Daedra, this preserved sac can hold acids known to burn through more common materials.
name: Hunger Acid Sac

title: Water Testing Rod
flavorText: This thumb-sized steel rod, when dipped in water, reveals whether a mortal may safely drink it. Useful in non-mortal planes.
name: Water Testing Rod

title: Ogrim Belly Spoon
flavorText: This thin, curved piece of obsidian aids in easing Ogrim torsos into armor or through narrow doorways.
name: Ogrim Belly Spoon

title: Tattered Havocrel War Blindfold
flavorText: A ragged sash of dark cotton embroidered with silver runes along the seams. Splashes of blood stain the edges.
name: Tattered Havocrel War Blindfold

title: Jar of Mortal Eye Jelly Polish
flavorText: Well-known among Daedra as the best polish for metal weaponry, this substance is made from freshly crushed mortal sight organs.
name: Jar of Mortal Eye Jelly Polish

title: Polished Watcher Monocle
flavorText: Specially crafted to fit a Watcher's primary eye, the lens focuses their magic while also appearing stylish.
name: Polished Watcher Monocle

title: Reinforced Twilight Umbrella
flavorText: Made from the wings of a Greivous Twilight, this item protects the most haughty Dremora against the Deadlands' savage storms.
name: Reinforced Twilight Umbrella

title: Dremora Station Brooch
flavorText: This complex ornamental pin announces the rank of an esteemed Dremora within their clan hierarchy.
name: Dremora Station Brooch

title: Ceremonial Glass Prayer Beads
flavorText: Worn by some mortal followers of Mehrunes Dagon, the maroon beads signify each sacrifice made in the Prince's name.
name: Ceremonial Glass Prayer Beads

title: Vampiric Lineage Chart
flavorText: This pocket-sized chart supposedly provides quick reference to the different forms of vampirism, for use in identifying kin.
name: Vampiric Lineage Chart

title: Bloodfiend Restraining Manacles
flavorText: Forged from iron, these manacles are used to hold feral bloodfiends until it becomes useful to release them onto prey.
name: Bloodfiend Restraining Manacles

title: Ivory Lamae Bal Figurine
flavorText: Carved from a solid piece of ivory, this small figure of the first vampire always feels cold to the touch.
name: Ivory Lamae Bal Figurine

title: Harvest Heart Fragment
flavorText: A pitted, jagged fragment from one of Molag Bal's Harvest Hearts in Coldharbour. Light around it seems to dim.
name: Harvest Heart Fragment

title: Waxed Neck Tap
flavorText: A vampire inserts this small wooden device into the neck of a mortal providing ease of access to its vital contents.
name: Waxed Neck Tap

title: Fang-Resistent Bat Leather Muzzle
flavorText: This muzzle covers a vampire's mouth, preventing any fanged attack. Frequently used by family members seeking a cure.
name: Fang-Resistent Bat Leather Muzzle

title: Vitrified Sand of Old Mournhold
flavorText: This foggy shard of glass was reputedly formed from a lightning strike during Mehrunes Dagon's First Era attack on Mournhold.
name: Vitrified Sand of Old Mournhold

title: Ogrim Nipple Caps
flavorText: These copper accents add a splash of color and style to the Daedra about town.
name: Ogrim Nipple Caps

title: Horn Wax
flavorText: Applying just a small dollop of this mash of skein wasp comb and carapace to your horns results in more lustrous, vivid color.
name: Horn Wax

title: Copper Fang Splints
flavorText: These cosmetic extensions result in almost comically long fangs, but they make a dramatic fashion statement.
name: Copper Fang Splints

title: Cobalt Lipstick
flavorText: The striking color comes from the ground Yaghra carapace.
name: Cobalt Lipstick

title: Obsidian Teeth Gloss
flavorText: This dark mixture is intended to be applied directly to one's teeth to create a more fearsome scowl.
name: Obsidian Teeth Gloss

title: Rose Foundation
flavorText: Imported from the realm of Moonshadow, its subtle pinks are from the delicate petals of flowering trees.
name: Rose Foundation

title: Carapace Love Charm
flavorText: This keratinous chunk of Hunger flesh hangs from a leather thong, said to bring luck in carnal affairs.
name: Carapace Love Charm

title: Fiendroth Cocoon
flavorText: Dark sorcerers speak of foul rituals that use this silken shell as a way to draw the hive to Nirn.
name: Fiendroth Cocoon

title: Banekin Earring Chain
flavorText: A binding ritual focus as well as a dashing fashion statement.
name: Banekin Earring Chain

title: Clannfear Bridle
flavorText: Along this leather harness run runes speaking to the strength of this beast's master, a powerful Dremora named Kathutet.
name: Clannfear Bridle

title: Etched Twilight Fang
flavorText: Capped with gold and inscribed with dark runes, this tooth came from a massive Grievous Daedra.
name: Etched Twilight Fang

title: Elemental Imbuement Phial
flavorText: A smidge of simmering red goo remains within, the focus for a ritual to imbue Atronach energies within a mortal shell.
name: Elemental Imbuement Phial

title: Crowfeather Crown
flavorText: A circle of barbed wire woven with lice-ridden feathers. Acts as a focus and binding for the crow servants of Nocturnal.
name: Crowfeather Crown

title: Fractured True Name Glyph
flavorText: Smelling faintly of brimstone, this cracked glyph was once used by a mortal sorcerer to bind a Daedra to their will.
name: Fractured True Name Glyph

title: Flagon from the Bearer's Rest
flavorText: This tin vessel is stamped with the sigil of Fargrave's tavern. Teeth marks pit its surface all around the rim.
name: Flagon from the Bearer's Rest

title: Crow's Perch Vessel
flavorText: Carved from a tree that only grows in Nocturnal's Evergloam, the cup is marked by black and purple whorls.
name: Crow's Perch Vessel

title: Ashstained Stein
flavorText: This stout cup was clearly intended to drink liquids, or magma, heated to very high temperature.
name: Ashstained Stein

title: Zealot's Jug
flavorText: A brown clay drinking vessel absolutely writhing with sigils from the Shivering Isles' realm of Mania. Hurts to look at.
name: Zealot's Jug

title: Scricture Officer's Canteen
flavorText: Emblazoned with the symbol of Fargrave's Stricture, the liquid inside is pungent and foul.
name: Scricture Officer's Canteen

title: Soulskull Goblet
flavorText: Pale light emanates from the sockets of this drinking vessel, made from the skull of a Ruinarch.
name: Soulskull Goblet

title: Khajiiti Commemorative Mug
flavorText: Apparently painted in celebration of the naming of a new Mane at the city of Dune. The Mane's name has been chipped away.
name: Khajiiti Commemorative Mug

title: Black Iron Fishing Hook
flavorText: Ragged flesh still hangs from the cruel barbs along its length.
name: Black Iron Fishing Hook

title: Planar Sextant
flavorText: Notations along its length make it clear this would be useless for sailing the oceans of Nirn.
name: Planar Sextant

title: Titan-Eye Fly
flavorText: This fly has been tied with several crow feathers and adorned with a Daedric Titan's eye. It is still twitching.
name: Titan-Eye Fly

title: Daedric Fishle
flavorText: An enterprising sorcerer thought to create a whistle to call forth Oblivion fish. Works just as well as the original.
name: Daedric Fishle

title: Black Iron Tongs
flavorText: The high heat these implements can withstand make them perfect for Daedric smelting.
name: Black Iron Tongs

title: Ruinach's Apron
flavorText: This massive apron would allow a four-armed smith to work at a forge.
name: Ruinach's Apron

title: Sack of Daedroth Teeth
flavorText: In the hands of the right smith, these teeth are even better than nails.
name: Sack of Daedroth Teeth

title: Blaze-Vein Purifier
flavorText: This small metal apparatus is heated to forge-hot temperatures to reach the purity needed for smithing.
name: Blaze-Vein Purifier

title: Nickel Etching Needle
flavorText: A permanent mystical imbuement means the tip of this tool smolders without ceasing.
name: Nickel Etching Needle

title: Illustrated Fargrave Folio
flavorText: A book of colorful illustrations for a variety of Daedric armors and weapons throughout the planes of Oblivion.
name: Illustrated Fargrave Folio

title: Daedra Doll Kit
flavorText: Clearly made by a mortal, these small-scale figurines would help a smith design armor for inhuman forms.
name: Daedra Doll Kit

title: Fargrave Inspirational Posters
flavorText: A sheaf of small posters with inspirational quotes. "Bathe in Blood," "Carnage is Peace," Be Violence," and so on.
name: Fargrave Inspirational Posters

title: Plaza of Portals Cheat Sheet
flavorText: A hastily scrawled tract reminding its writer which portals go where. There are many corrections and crossouts.
name: Plaza of Portals Cheat Sheet

title: Anti-Stricture Tract
flavorText: Some mortal penned this screed, which urges open rebellion against the Stricture. It is stained with blood.
name: Anti-Stricture Tract

title: Adolot's Cake Recipe
flavorText: This Daedra's definition of cake is an imaginative interpretation of the word. Not a single ingredient is safe for mortals.
name: Adolot's Cake Recipe

title: Menu from Madam Whim's
flavorText: Point by point list of the experiences, types of information, sensations, urges, and memories available at the Madam's.
name: Menu from Madam Whim's

title: Soulforged I.O.U.
flavorText: An itemized list showing a debt to a shifty character named Xyxevan. The currency being exchanged is apparently not coins.
name: Soulforged I.O.U.

title: Illicit Letters from Fargrave
flavorText: Extremely spicy correspondence between a mortal gentleman of means and a Daedric warrior poet.
name: Illicit Letters from Fargrave

title: Madam Whim's Little Black Book
flavorText: Penned in a scrawl incomprehensible to mortal eyes, this is no doubt one of many such tomes kept by the secret-monger.
name: Madam Whim's Little Black Book

title: Gargantuan's Tooth
flavorText: A massive, fossilized tooth, perhaps pried free from one of the enormous skulls littering the landscape beyond Fargrave.
name: Gargantuan's Tooth

title: Tortured Effigy
flavorText: This doll's smile is stitched closed, its stuffing leaks from various stab wounds, and its legs are blanketed with scorch marks.
name: Tortured Effigy

title: Dissection Doll
flavorText: This faceless horror is stuffed with facsimiles of organs which can be placed in a variety of different locations.
name: Dissection Doll

title: Monstrous Shadow Puppets
flavorText: Ranging from stalking beasts to a hand clutching an axe, these spindly puppets cast horrifying shadows.
name: Monstrous Shadow Puppets

title: Lost Spirit Marionette
flavorText: A ghostly looking doll whose eyes seem to follow you regardless of where you move.
name: Lost Spirit Marionette

title: Oversized Stuffed Bat
flavorText: The bat's fangs protrude from its mouth and its wings are leathery. It looks like it could leap up and attack at any moment.
name: Oversized Stuffed Bat

title: Stuffed Watcher
flavorText: The Watcher's tendrils hang limply in the air and its pupils list aimlessly in whichever direction it is tilted.
name: Stuffed Watcher

title: Well-Loved Bear
flavorText: This toy's fur is worn and it's missing an eye, signs of many years of nights spent cuddled to a sleeping chest.
name: Well-Loved Bear

title: Tapestry Tablecloth
flavorText: A thickly woven tapestry depicting a hunting scene. The fabric is saturated with candle drippings.
name: Tapestry Tablecloth

title: Bubble Pillow
flavorText: A translucent blue rectangle that molds itself delightfully under the pressure of something resting on it.
name: Bubble Pillow

title: Quilt of Fallen Flags
flavorText: A quilted blanket made from the banners of defeated armies and cities.
name: Quilt of Fallen Flags

title: Lover's Kerchief
flavorText: A decadently lush purple pocked kerchief that would succeed in catching an amorous eye anywhere.
name: Lover's Kerchief

title: Blue Floral Picnic Blanket
flavorText: The cloth is sandy and a little damp from the fountains around Fargrave, but the colors are vibrant under the starlight.
name: Blue Floral Picnic Blanket

title: Dowry Sampler Napkin
flavorText: A swatch of Imperial cloth embroidered with initials and a multitude of unfinished family crests.
name: Dowry Sampler Napkin

title: Whispering Puzzle Box
flavorText: The sides of the box are inscribed with runes and a voice can be heard calling out from a crack in the lid.
name: Whispering Puzzle Box

title: Movements of the Stars and Rituals
flavorText: A hefty star-studded tome held closed by a thick leather clasp.
name: Movements of the Stars and Rituals

title: Elemental Clock
flavorText: A timekeeping contraption which can be set to spew water during the morning hours and light a merry flame at night.
name: Elemental Clock

title: Calling Cards of Arcana
flavorText: A set of painted tarot cards, each with a unique magical signature inscribed upon them.
name: Calling Cards of Arcana

title: Prototype Flame-Resistant Robes
flavorText: A long garment embroidered with runes; it's covered in burns and scorch marks that render it unwearable.
name: Prototype Flame-Resistant Robes

title: Scryer's Basin
flavorText: A polished metal bowl that's deep enough to hold water but shallow enough to see images of faraway places.
name: Scryer's Basin

title: Balm of Lavender and Many-Colored Coral
flavorText: A vial of iridescent liquid that lets off a pleasing floral scent and brings tears of joy to the eyes of any who smell it.
name: Balm of Lavender and Many-Colored Coral

title: Dagger of Infinite Dullness
flavorText: An exquisitely crafted golden knife with a blade so blunt it could not dent itself.
name: Dagger of Infinite Dullness

title: Ever Sweeping Broom
flavorText: A household object that will clean the floor so long as there's a glyph embedded in the handle.
name: Ever Sweeping Broom

title: Jar of Healing Flame
flavorText: A glass jar marked with a Dragon. It is sealed very tightly and there does not seem to be a way to feed the fire inside.
name: Jar of Healing Flame

title: Gigantic Tongue
flavorText: An enormous tongue suspended in oil. The tastebuds look inflamed and possibly infected.
name: Gigantic Tongue

title: Box of Fingernails
flavorText: A wooden box filled with fingernails and clippings of different lengths. Each nail is catalogued and organized carefully.
name: Box of Fingernails

title: Eyeball Collection
flavorText: A glass case of a variety of ocular organs. The eyes are arranged by a color, shape, and size.
name: Eyeball Collection

title: Buds of Abdominal Avulsion
flavorText: These vibrant petals are surrounded by carefully written notes warning against their use in all known languages.
name: Buds of Abdominal Avulsion

title: Quick Cordial
flavorText: A vial of thick liquid printed with instructions to give to anyone afflicted by Mantikora venom.
name: Quick Cordial

title: Solar Cycle Stone
flavorText: A jagged geode that exudes a soft golden glow. Standing next to the stone feels like bathing in a pool of sunlight.
name: Solar Cycle Stone

title: Tome of the Irritating Dead
flavorText: A thick book filled with the names of mortals who disappeared or died mysteriously across Tamriel.
name: Tome of the Irritating Dead

title: Arm of Bloodless Incision
flavorText: The diagram of how a healer managed to remove his own arm, without spilling a drop of blood, is attached to the container.
name: Arm of Bloodless Incision

title: Mantikora Tail Spikes
flavorText: A collection of spikey protrusions taken from the tails of Mantikora.
name: Mantikora Tail Spikes

title: Ear of the Watcher's Pet
flavorText: Fur has been wrenched out of the ear in neat circles by the suction of the Watcher's tentacles.
name: Ear of the Watcher's Pet

title: Dried Mortal's Hearts
flavorText: Each heart is expertly dried and preserved; a few smell faintly of marinades and spices.
name: Dried Mortal's Hearts

title: Foot of Many Toes
flavorText: A severed Orcish foot with the toes of other mortals sewn on at awkward angles. It inspires a simple question: Why?
name: Foot of Many Toes

title: Stomach Purse
flavorText: A tanned mortal stomach stuffed with crimson geodes.
name: Stomach Purse

title: Hermaeus Mora's All-Knowing Eye Idol
flavorText: A large metal orb said to be modeled after the Lord of Secrets' own golden eyes.
name: Hermaeus Mora's All-Knowing Eye Idol

title: Golden Ever-Burning Flame Fetish
flavorText: A flame, carved from pure gold and resting on a rounded base so that the fire is always in motion.
name: Golden Ever-Burning Flame Fetish

title: Clavicus Vile's Loyal Dog Statue
flavorText: A rusted and tarnished iron figurine of a shaggy dog given to servants by nobles during the New Life Festival.
name: Clavicus Vile's Loyal Dog Statue

title: Defiled Aedric Statue
flavorText: A statue of good quality and make, but the head and all defining features either went missing or were carved out.
name: Defiled Aedric Statue

title: Sphere of Nirn
flavorText: This fine marble orb features a rough etching of Tamriel, Yokuda, and Akavir, but the locations appear totally out of place.
name: Sphere of Nirn

title: Charm of Protection from the Night
flavorText: Mortals burn this candle in front of the serpentine figurines to keep Vaermina from infiltrating their dreams.
name: Charm of Protection from the Night

title: Scene of Ancestral Duty
flavorText: A collection of miniature urns and offering plates. A comfort to many Dark Elves who are far from home.
name: Scene of Ancestral Duty

title: Aldmeri Dominion Belt Buckle
flavorText: A highly polished belt buckle in the shape of a eagle; the rest of the belt is missing.
name: Aldmeri Dominion Belt Buckle

title: Crimson Torchbug Lantern
flavorText: A jar with leaves, grasses, and twigs which can keep torchbugs alive and let their rosy light shine throughout a room.
name: Crimson Torchbug Lantern

title: Hanging Stars
flavorText: Small star-shaped ornaments with holes poked through one point so they can be hung on walls or strung from the ceiling.
name: Hanging Stars

title: Escape-Proof Daedrat Habitat
flavorText: A small wrought iron pen emblazoned with arcane wards. No Daedrat can escape this enclosure.
name: Escape-Proof Daedrat Habitat

title: Ruby Heart of Quartz
flavorText: An orb of clear quartz surrounding a moderately sized ruby, there are no facets or evidence that the quartz has been opened.
name: Ruby Heart of Quartz

title: Reman's Death Bookends
flavorText: One bookend shows a dagger emerging from the books while the other is a figure of Reman III falling dead.
name: Reman's Death Bookends

title: Rose Painted Skull
flavorText: A skull carefully painted with roses and surrounded by petals. Hidden inside one of the eye sockets is a dried peach.
name: Rose Painted Skull

title: Gem of Temporal Magic
flavorText: A gemstone that undergoes all stages of its formation at once. The diamond layer on the outside hides the molten core within.
name: Gem of Temporal Magic

title: Exquisite Whetstone and Polishing Kit
flavorText: Inlaid with precious gems and the finest oils, this kit can hone edges that will not dull and keep hilts oiled for eons.
name: Exquisite Whetstone and Polishing Kit

title: Deadlands Treasure Hunter's Parcel
flavorText: This container holds a selection of treasure maps, to be put to the test by would-be treasure hunters.
name: Deadlands Treasure Hunter's Parcel

title: Arena Gladiator's Revenge
abilityDescription: When you have at least thirty Gladiator Proofs: Use to consume those thirty Proofs and create a Runebox: Siegestomper Emote.
flavorText: This ancient Imperial verse epitomizes the vengeance of an Arena Gladiator.
name: Arena Gladiator's Revenge

title: Runebox: Siegestomper Emote
flavorText: Contains a Siegestomper Emote. This container can be traded, mailed, and posted to Guild Banks and Guild Stores - however, once opened, the Runebox (and its contents) are bound to your account.
name: Runebox: Siegestomper Emote

title: Antique Map of the Deadlands
flavorText: Long ago, several explorers of the Burn and the Sever worked together to map out these areas of the Deadlands, though regrettably not all who started this cartography project lived to see its result.
name: Antique Map of the Deadlands

title: Deadlands Recipe Envelope
flavorText: This box contains a variety of Furniture Recipes to be introduced in the Deadlands.
name: Deadlands Recipe Envelope

title: Bushes, Withered Cluster
flavorText: This is a standard house item.
name: Bushes, Withered Cluster

title: Music Box: Wonders of the Shoals
flavorText: When activated, plays a music box arrangement of the whimsical "Wonders of the Shoals" composition.
name: Music Box: Wonders of the Shoals

title: Music Box: Bleak Beacon Shanty
flavorText: When activated, plays a music box arrangement of the eldritch "Bleak Beacon Shanty" composition.
name: Music Box: Bleak Beacon Shanty
